name: Connection failures name the right cause
prose: a 401 says the base URL *or* the key may be wrong (gateways authenticate before routing, so a wrong URL returns 401 too) and points at TEST, which can tell them apart; a 404 says the model id may need to be fully qualified.
invariant: A 401 says the base URL or the key may be wrong and points at TEST; a 404 says the model id may need qualifying.
